verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur sikh sun gursikh bhe gur sikh man gursikh man maane hai ||

en.bdb: Blessed is he who accepting Guru's advice become his disciple (devotee). In the process his mind is reassured in the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਭਾਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਾਉ ਚਾਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਜਾਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh bhai gursikh bhaau chaau ridhai gur sikh jaan gursikh jag jaane hai ||

en.bdb: By accepting his (Guru's) teachings with faith, love and enthusiasm develops in the heart of a devotee. He who labours on the teachings of Guru with singular mind, becomes known as a true Sikh of the Guru the world over.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh milai gursikh pooran hui gursikh pooran braham pahichaane hai ||

en.bdb: The union of Guru and his Sikh by virtue of strenuous meditation on Lord's name that enables him practice Guru's teachings sincerely and adeptly, the Sikh then recognises the complete Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੧੪੯॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh prem nem gur sikh sikh gur soha(n) soiee bees ik iees ur aane hai ||149||

en.bdb: The sincerity of the Sikh in labouring on the teachings of his Guru brings both together to the extent of becoming one. Believe it! By repeated incantations of Waheguru, Waheguru (Lord) and Tuhi Tuhi (He alone, He alone), he lodges the Lord in his heart. (149)
